label: TAF15::ZNF384

sections.text: TAF15 encodes an RNA-binding transcriptional regulator in the FET protein family.
ZNF384 encodes a zinc-finger transcriptional regulator.

The fusion joins a transcriptional-regulatory partner to ZNF384 and alters hematopoietic lineage programs. ZNF384-rearranged leukemia often shows weak CD10 with aberrant CD13/CD33 expression and can have B-lineage/myeloid phenotypic overlap.
